mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_record (task_id, course_id, teacher_uid, stu_token, dim1, dim2, dim3, dim4, suggestion, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{courseId}, #{teacherUid}, #{stuToken}, #{dim1}, #{dim2}, #{dim3}, #{dim4}, #{suggestion}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, c.credit, t.tid AS teacherUid, t.name AS teacherName FROM course_selection cs JOIN course c ON c.course_id = cs.course_id JOIN course_arrange a ON a.course_id = cs.course_id AND a.tid IS NOT NULL JOIN teacher t ON t.tid = a.tid WHERE cs.sid = #{sid} AND cs.semester_id = #{semesterId} GROUP BY c.course_id, c.name, c.credit, t.tid, t.name ORDER BY c.course_id, t.tid
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_selection WHERE sid = #{sid} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND semester_id = #{semesterId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_arrange WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND tid = #{teacherUid}

SELECT er.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, er.teacher_uid AS teacherUid, t.name AS teacherName, COUNT(*) AS recordCount, ROUND(AVG(er.dim1), 2) AS avgDim1, ROUND(AVG(er.dim2), 2) AS avgDim2, ROUND(AVG(er.dim3), 2) AS avgDim3, ROUND(AVG(er.dim4), 2) AS avgDim4, ROUND((AVG(er.dim1) + AVG(er.dim2) + AVG(er.dim3) + AVG(er.dim4)) / 4, 2) AS avgTotal FROM evaluation_record er LEFT JOIN course c ON c.course_id = er.course_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON t.tid = er.teacher_uid WHERE er.task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY er.course_id, c.name, er.teacher_uid, t.name ORDER BY avgTotal DESC, recordCount DESC
SELECT suggestion FROM evaluation_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND teacher_uid = #{teacherUid} AND suggestion IS NOT NULL AND suggestion != '' ORDER BY id
